name: Vinyl
author: shoxjaxon
description: A minimal local music player for the Omarchy bar. Choose your music folder once: every song in it, subfolders included, is in one list — click a song and it plays, with no player to start and no player window. A mini-player, your own playlists, and it remembers where you stopped, even after a restart. Also shows other local MPRIS players. No network access, no background scanning.

barWidget.description: Now-playing indicator with a mini-player and a music library
